from sage.all import *
R=PolynomialRing(QQ, names=('k','x','y','e0','e1','e2','w0','w1','w2'))
A=ExteriorAlgebra(R, names=('z0','z1','z2','p0','p1','p2','q0','q1','q2','l'))
z=A.gens()
f=z[0]*z[2]*z[4]
print('Sage version:', version())
print('Basis keys:', list(f.monomial_coefficients().items()))
print('Methods:', [s for s in dir(f) if 'deriv' in s or 'interior' in s or 'contract' in s])
print('Generator anticommutation:', z[0]*z[1]+z[1]*z[0]==0)
